title: Dal Fry
instructions: Cook dal with turmeric and salt. Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, tomato, and spices. Mix and simmer.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Cook tomato gravy with butter and spices, add paneer cubes, finish with cream.

title: Chole (Chickpea Curry)
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight, pressure cook, then simmer with onion-tomato masala and spices.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Sauté potato and cauliflower with spices until tender, garnish with coriander.

title: Masoor Dal
instructions: Cook red lentils with turmeric, prepare onion-tomato tadka, mix and simmer.

title: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Cook rice with sautéed vegetables and whole spices, serve hot.

title: Sambar
instructions: Cook dal, add tamarind extract and sambar powder, simmer with vegetables and curry leaves.

title: Rasam
instructions: Prepare tamarind base, add rasam powder and tomato, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

title: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast eggplant, mash, cook with onion-tomato masala and spices.

title: Idli
instructions: Soak rice and dal, grind to batter, ferment overnight, steam in idli molds.
